messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Increased generation latency observed in eu-west-1 for hosted text-generation endpoints. Error spikes and token queues rising. Paging SRE rotation. https://metrics.redwood.internal/graphs/xyz :loud_sound:
tilly_sre: Acknowledged. I'm on it, jumping into genqueue + router logs now. Can someone verify customer-impact boundaries? especially dedicated vs hosted tiers?
alex_eng: Confirming hosted API and some small dedicated pools see elevated tail latency. No 5xx spike yet. KV cache hit rate dropping on ~long-seq workloads.
luis_ops: Tilly, I can warm additional eu-west-1 GPUs and enable the routing fallback to eu-central if you want immediate relief. That will add cross-region latency for affected customers. /cc @kim_cs for customer comms tradeoff.
tilly_sre: Do it. Activate fallback and start autoscale warm. I'll tail genqueue logs.
oncall-rotation-bot: oncall handoff: tilly_sre is primary for the next 2 hours. Pagerduty link: https://pd.redwood/INC-3219
kim_cs: Heads-up CS. If we route customers to eu-central, some latency-sensitive apps will notice latency increase. Recommend we draft a status note that says "degraded generation latency for eu-west-1; optional routing to eu-central may increase latency for some workloads".
rach_legal: Quick reminder: avoid words like "outage" and any promise of timelines. Use "degraded" and "mitigations in progress". Also flag any regulated customers we should notify directly.
jordan_pm: Also capture the ETA for fallback complete and current mitigation steps. Customers want to know if their jobs are still processing.
luis_ops: Draft for status page initial (please review):
```
Initial update: We are investigating elevated generation latency in eu-west-1 affecting hosted text generation. Engineers are activating fallback routing to eu-central and warming capacity. Some customers may see longer response times while we mitigate. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.```
ntilly_sre: LGTM but add "no evidence of data loss" per legal.
luis_ops: Updated draft and posting now — posting to internal status preview first. /status preview done. Link: https://status.redwood.internal/preview/INC-3219
kim_cs: Quick copy for public status page audience (short):
"We are investigating increased generation latency in eu-west-1. Traffic is being routed to eu-central as a mitigation; some users may see higher latency. Our engineers are actively working on a permanent fix."
rach_legal: That wording is ok. Avoid saying "permanent" — suggest "longer-term fix".
kim_cs: Updated: "We are investigating increased generation latency in eu-west-1. Traffic is being routed to eu-central as a mitigation; some users may see higher latency. Engineers are working on a longer-term fix."
luis_ops: Published initial status update to public page. Notifying enterprise contacts.
tilly_sre: 09:14 UTC update: fallback routing active, ingress queues decreasing ~30%, token processing rate improving. Still seeing occasional long tail tasks.
ajex_eng: (typo) alex_eng: digging into a model-specific KV cache thrash; patch to cache eviction logic being tested in stage. If test passes, will roll to prod canary in eu-west-1.
jordan_pm: Please include in next public update ETA for canary: ~30-45min if tests pass.
kim_cs: Drafting 15min update for public page now.
luis_ops: 09:29 UTC update published: Mitigations active; routing fallback reducing impact; canary roll for cache fix queued. No customer data exposure detected.
tilly_sre: 09:42 UTC: Canary passed in staging, rolling a small canary in eu-west-1 to 5% of traffic. Monitoring.
kim_cs: I sent targeted emails to 12 enterprise contacts that flagged eu-west latency in the last 24h.
rach_legal: Thanks. Keep the language factual.
tilly_sre: 10:02 UTC: Canary looks good at 5% — promoting to 25% then 100% over next 20 minutes. Queues continue to normalize.
luis_ops: I'll hold fallback routing once promotion passes 50%.
tilly_sre: 10:26 UTC: Cache eviction fix rolled to 100% in eu-west-1. Token queues at baseline, p50/p95 latency returned to normal.
luis_ops: Published resolved notice to public status page: "Resolved: Generation latency issue in eu-west-1. Services operating normally; customers may experience short-term increased latencies while we completed mitigation. For questions contact support@redwood.ai"
kim_cs: Sent follow-up customer email with timeline and what happened.
rach_legal: Final check — wording updated to avoid absolutes. Good to go.
jordan_pm: Thanks all. Please open a post-incident doc with timeline, root cause (KV eviction thrash), remediation, and follow-up action item to add better cache telemetry and automated eviction safety.
tilly_sre: I'll start the postmortem doc and assign action items. Closing the pager. :white_check_mark:
